import requests
import json
import re

# Get the content of the June 2023 revision for August 1
url = "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php"

headers = {
    'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; WikipediaResearch/1.0; +https://example.com/bot)'
}

params = {
    "action": "query",
    "format": "json",
    "prop": "revisions",
    "titles": "August 1",
    "revids": "1162212811",  # The June 2023 revision ID
    "rvprop": "content|timestamp"
}

try:
    response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers=headers)
    print("Response status:", response.status_code)
    
    if response.status_code == 200:
        data = response.json()
        
        # Extract content
        pages = data.get('query', {}).get('pages', {})
        for page_id, page_data in pages.items():
            if 'revisions' in page_data:
                revision = page_data['revisions'][0]
                content = revision.get('content', '')
                timestamp = revision.get('timestamp', '')
                
                print(f"Revision from: {timestamp}")
                print(f"Content length: {len(content)} characters")
                
                # Count Twitter/X citations
                twitter_citations = 0
                
                # Look for cite tweet template
                cite_tweet_count = len(re.findall(r'\{\{cite tweet', content, re.IGNORECASE))
                twitter_citations += cite_tweet_count
                
                # Look for tweet template  
                tweet_count = len(re.findall(r'\{\{tweet', content, re.IGNORECASE))
                twitter_citations += tweet_count
                
                # Look for twitter.com URLs in references
                twitter_url_count = len(re.findall(r'twitter\.com', content, re.IGNORECASE))
                
                # Look for x.com URLs (though shouldn't be many in June 2023)
                x_url_count = len(re.findall(r'x\.com', content, re.IGNORECASE))
                
                print(f"Cite tweet templates: {cite_tweet_count}")
                print(f"Tweet templates: {tweet_count}")
                print(f"twitter.com URLs: {twitter_url_count}")
                print(f"x.com URLs: {x_url_count}")
                print(f"Total Twitter/X citations found: {twitter_citations}")
                
                # Show a sample of the references section
                if '<references>' in content.lower():
                    refs_start = content.lower().find('<references>')
                    refs_end = content.lower().find('</references>', refs_start)
                    if refs_end != -1:
                        refs_section = content[refs_start:refs_end+13]

    else:
        print("Response text:", response.text[:500])
